a little about me

QUMI FASHION

Styling & Profiling

Qumi Fashion is a Lagos-based Fashion Stylist, Costume Designer & Image Consultant with a deep love for creative storytelling through clothing. Her top priority is making clients feel good — from the inside out.

She creates looks that bring your personality to life. From the clothes to the shoes, to the accessories — she doesn't just pull a look together, she brings it alive.

From editorial shoots to globally broadcast campaigns with the Gates Foundation, featuring MI, Layi Wasabi & Brodda Shaggi — every project is rooted in culture, creativity, and purpose.
